learn.dispatchBody: The system looks within 3 km, then 6 and 10 km|The closest handyman with high rating and activity gets the offer first|You have 60 seconds to decide|Clients who added you to "My handymen" send you the offer first
learn.activityBody: Accept +2, decline or no answer −5, cancel −10|Activity ranges 0 to 100|Higher activity means more orders
learn.ratingBody: Arrive on time; message the client if late|Agree the price before starting|Leave the place clean|Add photos of your work
learn.moneyBody: The client pays the call-out and labour in cash|On commission, the platform share is taken from your balance|If the balance drops below the limit, orders pause|On subscription there is no percentage — pay once a month
learn.safetyBody: Take orders only through the app|If something feels wrong, message support|Follow safety rules with electricity and gas

settings.notificationsHint: Your phone will alert you about new orders
